Product Description

These are running shoes anyone can wear to go faster—with Charged Cushioning® to help protect against impact, a breathable upper, and durability for miles.. Lightweight, breathable mesh upper with synthetic overlays for added durability & support. EVA sockliner provides soft, step-in comfort. Charged Cushioning® midsole uses compression molded foam for ultimate responsiveness & durability. Solid rubber outsole covers high impact zones for greater durability with less weight. Offset: 10mm. Weight: 9.5 oz.. Lace type: Standard tie. NEUTRAL: For runners who need flexibility, cushioning & versatility". Warning: This product can expose you to chemicals including chromium (hexavalent compounds), which is known in the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm.. .

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these shoes comfortable, with feet not hurting during wear, and appreciate their great fit, particularly for wide feet. They provide good arch support and are lightweight, feeling like they're "gliding" on the feet, while offering good value for the price. The sizing receives mixed feedback, with some finding them true to size while others note they run small, and durability is also mixed, with some saying they hold up to daily wear while others report them falling apart after three months.

Amazing Shoes! Go a size up though.
First off, the shoes feel VERY light compared to my regular shoes which is a bonus for me. I only use these shoes for walking/jogging/sprinting and they feel great for all of them. Second, go about half a size up from your regulars as they fit a little tight. Nevertheless, got these on sale and they look and feel great! Worth the purchase.

  • reJulien
    5 out of 5 stars
    Secondo me, una gran scarpa da running che sta bene anche con i jeans.
    Reviewed in Italy on April 17, 2024
    Size: 9Color: (001) Black/Black/White
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Al di là del fatto che sono uno sportivo da sempre, devo ammettere che ho una passione sfegatata per le scarpe da ginnastica. Ne compro in continuazione, non riesco a smettere. Ne ho circa 30 paia dei miei marchi prediletti, che non son pochi. Naturalmente, Under Armour figura nella lista ed anche fra le prime posizioni per preferenza. Non sono fra le scarpe più "tecniche" ma sono sicuramente fra le più belle e confortevoli che si possano trovare sul mercato.

    Queste UA Charged Assert 10 sono bellissime e ben studiate. La calzata è ottima, la scarpa fascia bene e la suola, secondo me, ha la giusta consistenza per supportare una buona corsa offrendo ammortizzazione e rimbalzo ma senza cedere sotto il peso del passo. Per intenderci, la suola è in espanso, non tipo memory: non è di quelle che danno la sensazione di camminare sulle uova sode tipo Skechers o come svariate Nike. Quelle ultra-morbide, stile pantofola, van bene per pochi passi, un volo in aereo magari ma non si può andarci a correre o camminarci sopra per turismo un'intera giornata, non senza poi avere male ai piedi. Per correre ci vuole una suola come quella di queste Under Armour: non rigida ma reattiva e sostenuta e, la tomaia, non può essere un calzino. Anche quella deve offrire un po' di struttura su tutti i lati. Questa è una scarpa studiata da corsa e presenta i giusti contenuti tecnici.

    Se poi non è la prestazione sportiva ad interessarvi e state valutando questa scarpa come sneaker da jeans, beh, secondo me siete comunque nel posto giusto perché a livello estetico, queste scarpe, non hanno nulla da invidiare ad Adidas, Puma, Nike e compagnia bella.

    Per quanto riguarda i numeri, posso dirvi che io ho generalmente un 42 e, da sempre, su Under Armour acquisto il 42,5 con successo.

    Ciao!

About this Item

  • Lightweight, breathable mesh upper with synthetic overlays for added durability & support
  • EVA sockliner provides soft, step-in comfort
  • Charged Cushioning midsole uses compression molded foam for ultimate responsiveness & durability
  • Solid rubber outsole covers high impact zones for greater durability with less weight
  • Offset: 10mm
  • Warning: This product can expose you to chemicals including chromium (hexavalent compounds), which is known in the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm.

Product Description

These are running shoes anyone can wear to go faster—with Charged Cushioning® to help protect against impact, a breathable upper, and durability for miles. Lightweight, breathable mesh upper with synthetic overlays for added durability & support. EVA sockliner provides soft, step-in comfort. Charged Cushioning® midsole uses compression molded foam for ultimate responsiveness & durability. Solid rubber outsole covers high impact zones for greater durability with less weight. Offset: 10mm, Weight: 9.5 oz. Lace type: Standard tie. NEUTRAL: For runners who need flexibility, cushioning & versatility.
